meta.title: Decision Q&A — what must be known before reasonable decisions are possible
meta.legend: status: ANSWERED (source shown) · PARTIAL (some info, gaps listed) · UNKNOWN (no reliable answer — do NOT decide yet) · BLOCKED (waiting on external party)
meta.rule: If a question is UNKNOWN/BLOCKED, any dependent decision is also blocked. Missing answers are never filled by inference; they are discovered via the listed discovery action or stay blank.

questions.question: What is the permitted, reliable way to fetch official NFL data on a recurring basis (robots.txt, terms, rate limits)?
questions.why: Every re-verification and automation (SUG-04) depends on it; getting it wrong risks blocks or terms violations.
questions.current_answer: PARTIAL — nfl.com pages were fetchable on 2026-11-12 for one-off transcription; no official API terms for automated pulls have been reviewed.
questions.discovery: Read nfl.com terms of use + robots.txt; contact NFL data licensing or confirm Sportradar (official betting-data distributor) terms; check whether a developer program exists.

questions.question: Which official feed covers player game logs at the depth needed for prop correlations (S6)?
questions.why: Prop-combo correlation is the stated headline requirement; it is impossible without this.
questions.current_answer: UNKNOWN — no player game-log source has been acquired or verified this session; nfl-quant contains predictions whose provenance is not verified here.
questions.discovery: Evaluate official league stats endpoints and licensed providers; verify coverage, history length, permitted modeling use; record cost.

questions.question: Where is the official 2026 depth chart, and how are 2nd/3rd/4th-string replacements identified when a starter is out?
questions.why: The injury report lists practice status only; without depth order, 'deficiency' is unknowable and S4 is unexecutable.
questions.current_answer: PARTIAL — nfl.com/injuries lists W10 practice/game status (fetched, transcribed). Depth charts NOT yet ingested or verified.
questions.discovery: Locate official depth-chart page per team (nfl.com team pages); snapshot weekly; map DNP→replacement; flag when chart is stale.

questions.question: How should a backup's 'deficiency' be quantified (unit-level grade vs starter) and validated?
questions.why: Turns injury news into a measurable signal instead of narrative; required for S4 and for the defensive-deficiency watchlist.
questions.current_answer: UNKNOWN — no fitted replacement-delta model exists; would need historical pre/post-injury splits (SUG-05 data).
questions.discovery: Define position-group delta table (QB/RB/WR/OL/CB/S/LB/DL); fit on 2016–2026 game logs; validate on holdout seasons; register before use.

questions.question: Is there a budget and mandate for licensed odds data and any real leaderboard rewards?
questions.why: G7/G8 are blocked; without spend approval, 'originated lines' can never be compared to market and rewards stay virtual.
questions.current_answer: UNKNOWN — no budget, owner, or mandate documented anywhere in the repo or brief.
questions.discovery: Ask the project owner (this task's requester) for: licensed-data budget, reward funding, legal review scope, and decision criteria for 'best path'.

questions.question: Do the terms of any odds provider permit storing, modeling and republishing derived fair lines publicly on GitHub Pages?
questions.why: Publishing model outputs derived from licensed data may violate provider terms; must be cleared before public leaderboard with CLV.
questions.current_answer: UNKNOWN — no provider selected; no terms reviewed.
questions.discovery: Once provider chosen, review redistribution clause with counsel; otherwise restrict to virtual points and aggregate stats.

questions.question: What problem-gambling, age-gating and disclosure requirements apply to a public leaderboard that 'rewards top performing strategies'?
questions.why: Public-facing gambling-adjacent content carries legal and ethical duties; rewards could constitute a contest requiring rules/eligibility/tax handling.
questions.current_answer: PARTIAL — site carries NCPG helpline disclosure (1-800-MY-RESET) and 'not wagering advice' language. No legal review of rewards mechanics performed.
questions.discovery: Counsel review of contest/reward structure; add official rules page, eligibility, no-purchase-necessary mechanics if prizes are real.

questions.question: Which historical seasons and games are permitted for backtesting, and is any of it already in the repo (nfl-lab 120 games; nfl-quant bets) with known provenance?
questions.why: G3 needs n≥300; repo data may bootstrap it — but provenance must be verified, not assumed.
questions.current_answer: PARTIAL — nfl-lab/data/games_2026.csv: 120 games, internally consistent (re-checked 2026-11-12: 0 mismatches vs its standings file), every row carries nfl.com game URLs. Deeper 2016–2025 history: not present, provenance unknown.
questions.discovery: Audit nfl-lab game rows against official box scores for a random sample (e.g., 20 games); if pass rate 100%, adopt as seed; else re-derive from official sources.

questions.question: What multiple-testing and FDR policy applies across all reported correlations and strategy variants, now and after the harness exists?
questions.why: Luck removal demands a single, enforced correction; ad-hoc per-page q-values invite cherry-picking.
questions.current_answer: ANSWERED (policy) — Benjamini–Hochberg at q=0.05 across all tests reported together; this session reports 6 correlations with BH-adjusted q (FDR < 0.05). Enforcement in CI pending SUG-11.
questions.discovery: Adopt shared stats module + CI gate; count every registered strategy variant in the familywise correction.

questions.question: Should injury adjustment be a feature inside one model, or a separate registered strategy with its own gates?
questions.why: Determines registry design, sample splitting, and interpretability; mixing silently breaks pre-registration discipline.
questions.current_answer: ANSWERED (proposal) — separate registered strategy (S4′, SUG-06) sharing the base model; never a manual in-flight tweak; leaderboard counts both.
questions.discovery: Confirm with owner during strategy-registry review; freeze registry v1.1 before implementation.

questions.question: Who reviews leaderboard eligibility claims and resolves disputes (referee role), and how are ties broken?
questions.why: A competition without adjudication corrupts trust; needed before any reward exists.
questions.current_answer: UNKNOWN — no referee, dispute path, or tie-break rule documented.
questions.discovery: Draft competition rules: eligibility = all G-pass, CLV-weighted score, z vs permutation null, variance tiebreak, referee = repo owner or designated reviewer.

questions.question: Which dashboard is canonical (root vs nfl/ vs nfl-lab/ vs nfl-quant/ vs nfl-research/ vs nfl-intel/) and what happens to the rest?
questions.why: Parallel competing 'final' dashboards confuse reviewers and leak effort; also root rebuild is locked by the NBA canonical workflow.
questions.current_answer: PARTIAL — README documents each + notes root index.html is rebuilt byte-identically by the canonical NBA workflow; nfl-intel is additive and leaves peers untouched. Canonical decision not made.
questions.discovery: Owner decision recorded in COORDINATION.md; archive/redirect non-canonical namespaces; coordinate root edit with canonical workflow owner.

questions.question: How should 'choose the best path' reviews be run — who, how often, and where decisions are recorded?
questions.why: The requester wants a review gate before implementation; needs a defined cadence and decision log to be real, not decorative.
questions.current_answer: PARTIAL — this namespace adds a Suggestions register (12 items) with statuses + review protocol; no cadence/owner assigned yet.
questions.discovery: Owner names reviewer + cadence (e.g., weekly 15-min triage); decisions appended to decision journal (SUG-09).

questions.question: Which non-score feeds (weather, travel, altitude, referee) are official or verifiable enough to include?
questions.why: Rest/travel signal (S7) and totals models stall without them; unofficial scrape paths are off the table.
questions.current_answer: UNKNOWN — no weather/travel source vetted this session.
questions.discovery: Check official providers (e.g., league-partnered data for international games) and reputable public datasets with clear licenses; document terms per feed.

questions.question: Should a row-level 'source or blank' CI gate be enforced repo-wide, and what is the migration path for legacy pages?
questions.why: Prevents unsourced rows silently returning; requires agreement on allow-list vs fix-forward.
questions.current_answer: PARTIAL — nfl-intel verify_site.py implements the check locally; repo-wide enforcement not adopted.
questions.discovery: Propose CI job; allow-list legacy namespaces with dated sunset; ratchet over time.

questions.question: What vig/friction assumptions anchor 'fair line' vs 'bet line', given no official operator terms are available to model actual costs?
questions.why: G8 (costs & settlement) is blocked; without honest vig range, ROI claims are impossible — the site must keep claiming 'informational only'.
questions.current_answer: UNKNOWN — operator terms not reviewed; standard -110 is a modeling placeholder, not a verified figure for any specific book.
questions.discovery: Review at least two licensed/public-disclosure operator term sheets; publish assumed vig range with sources before any ROI statement.
